title: Customer capstone — one sealed envelope: an incident, a feature request and a governance constraint
feature: Learner's choice. You pick and combine the Devin capabilities from labs 01–14; nothing on this page tells you which.
prerequisites: Labs 01–14 attempted (at least their fixture paths), so you know what each capability does and costs
Repo cloned, `npm install` done at the root, Node 22, Docker for `npm run db:up`
A facilitator or the capstone coach to hand you a sealed envelope; you never choose or open it yourself
Half a day blocked in your calendar, with the voice call free to stay connected while you work

matrix.integration: Kadé stack (API, worker, PayGate fake, seed data, scenario injectors)
matrix.fixture: `npm run db:up && npm run lab:reset -- 15`, then `npm run dev:api`; every injector in `scenarios/` talks only to the API.
matrix.note: Zero credentials. This is the only part every envelope needs.

matrix.integration: Observability, paging and cloud evidence (Datadog, PagerDuty, AWS, GCP, BigQuery, Workspace)
matrix.fixture: `fixtures/mcp/` and its local shim, `observability/` and `infra/` (the same fixtures labs 07, 08 and 12 use).
matrix.note: Use a live connection only if your organization already has one; never ask anyone for credentials.

matrix.integration: Governance surfaces (Security Profiles, AI Guardrails, ACU limits, Outposts)
matrix.fixture: The offline models from labs 10, 11 and 14 (`labs/10-guardrails/solution/`, `labs/11-acu-analytics/tools/`, `labs/14-outposts/tools/`).
matrix.note: Changing a real organization setting needs an admin; the observer path is acceptable if you say so.

matrix.fixture: Speak the customer update on the call; a written copy goes in your capstone report.
matrix.note: Post nowhere the customer did not ask for.

credentials.fixture_only_story: Every envelope can be completed with the local stack and the repo's fixtures. Where a live integration would have been the natural choice, say so, show what the fixture proved and list the live step as not exercised.
not_exercised: Any live integration your organization has not already connected (you list which).
Organization-level settings you are not an admin for (you describe them, you do not change them).

reset: git switch main && git status --short (must print nothing) — work on your own leaf branch, never on main
scenarios.clean_state: Seed-spec dataset for both brands, no scenario orders, every planted defect still in place on `main`, `bad-migration.patch` not applied, `scenarios/.state/` empty, and you have not read anything under `labs/15-capstone/scenarios/`.

injectors.name: envelope
injectors.behaviour: The coach (or your facilitator) reads one sealed envelope to you in the customer's voice. It names an incident, a feature request and a governance constraint. You get it once; take notes.

injectors.name: requirement-change
injectors.behaviour: The customer changes one requirement, in character, without warning. Decide out loud what you keep, what you drop and what you re-plan.

injectors.name: injected-blocker
injectors.behaviour: Something you depend on stops working the way you expected. The coach will not tell you what it is.

injectors.name: cost-challenge
injectors.behaviour: Someone with a budget asks what this half day cost and whether it was worth it. Have your numbers.

injectors.name: security-objection
injectors.behaviour: Someone responsible for risk challenges a choice you made. You get a follow-up question if your answer skips evidence.
